rationale: Patch applies cleanly, passes allowlist and question-schema checks, and leaves UBU-Q0128 metadata and Status: Open untouched. It targets subquestion 5, the one envelope slice the prior decisions (D0309–D0311, D0322, D0333, D0359, D0365) left broad, and does so in the established style: a single decision record, a DESIGN.md §21.1.2 block with an allowlist table plus required fixtures, and matching current-direction and resolution updates.
